description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Complex Square 21, Rruga e Kavajes, Tirana. - Total area 108.8 m2 - Net area 93 m2 - 5th floor - Regular floor plan Organization: 2 bedrooms, spacious living room & kitchen, 2 bathrooms and two balconies. The Square 21 complex offers bright and spacious recreational spaces, ventilated facades, acoustic insulation inside the apartments, green spaces, flower gardens, swimming pool, sports facilities, shops, etc. For more information or a visit to the property, please contact us!
